notes: Topline: enterprise knowledge platform with 120M+ indexed docs; primary initiative is migrate embeddings + reranker to improve relevance and reduce per-query cost.

Customer-led pain: current vector infra costs are spiking with night/weekend batch reindexes; reranker run per-query adds 150ms on avg and costs ~3x token spend compared to first-party embeddings path.
ML Lead (Anika Rao): 'We will not accept quality regressions — must be parity or better in R@10 and MRR across our legal and product docs slices.'
Security: SOC2 in place; legal requires data residency for EU data and keys in customer KMS for on-prem testing.
Preference: start with Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization + prefix caching, then move reranker to Redwood-hosted dedicated GPUs if evaluation passes.
Risk: heavy index (120M vectors) — indexing throughput, shard strategy, and incremental reindexing required. They flagged possible eviction/consistency issues with KV-cache on cold-start.
They already tried a PoC with vendor X — saw 8% lift in MRR but 30% cost jump; want better cost/quality tradeoff and A/B safety net.
AE note: prioritize deliverables for POC: 1) eval set + slice definitions 2) automated regression alerts 3) canary rollout plan 4) cost model (p50/p95) per route.
CSM asked for onboarding doc and 90-day success criteria; will link to drive artifacts above.

requirements_summary: Migration to Redwood embeddings + reranker must preserve or improve retrieval quality across defined slices (legal, product, FAQs); support 120M doc index with incremental reindexing; stay within 20% increase of current latency p95 and reduce per-query cost by 15-30% vs current infra.
workload_profile: Hybrid: bursty QPS peaks 2k qps regionally; steady background reindexing jobs at night; mixture of short-chat style queries and long-document retrievals.
latency_targets: P50 < 50ms for embedding lookup, P95 < 250ms end-to-end for search+rerank (current p95 ~220ms).
cost_constraints: Target net per-query cost reduction 15-30%; committed ARR tradeoff acceptable for Dedicated if cost per qps predictable.
eval_strategy: Evals-driven migration: use existing 10k query eval set + per-slice metrics (R@5,R@10,MRR,precision@k). Run offline A/B on historical traffic and then 5% canary live traffic with automatic rollback on predefined regression thresholds (delta MRR > -1.5% or any slice drop > -3%).
